parsed_json.up: Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence from target_dictionary joined to target_components on tid, then joined to component_sequences on component_id. Filter target_dictionary where target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Map chembl_id to target_chembl_id, pref_name to target_name, accession to protein_accession, and sequence to protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
